description: Parker-Hannifin Corporation, incorporated in Ohio in 1938, is a global leader in motion and control technologies, and leveraging a unique combination of interconnected technologies it designs, manufactures and provides aftermarket support for highly engineered solutions that create value for customers primarily in aerospace and defense, in-plant and industrial equipment, transportation, off-highway, energy, and HVAC and refrigeration markets around the world. It values having a decentralized operating structure that fosters deeper connections with its customers and greater engagement among its team members, and to align its operations and achieve its goal of top quartile performance it deploys its business system, The Win Strategy, which establishes goals and strategies for engaged people, customers and suppliers.
